company_name: Advanced Materials Technology & Engineering Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in semiconductor manufacturing processes and has developed innovative equipment and materials for SiC technology.
summary: Advanced Materials Technology & Engineering Co., Ltd is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, focusing on the development of advanced materials and processes. Their notable contribution includes the CCP SiC Trench Etching Process, which significantly improves the performance of SiC MOSFETs by optimizing the conductive channel through a trench structure.

regional_presence.China: The company actively participates in industry exhibitions such as the China Semiconductor Equipment, Materials and Core Components Exhibition (CSEAC), indicating a strategic focus on the Chinese market.
